title: A check refuses an assistant message that holds notification markup, so a session never writes its own fake result
why: Coordinator 12:58 CST Nov 8: lane cite-range-symbol-match (session_013NEJL34KjkQwzUueKThXhM) reports it once wrote a fake task-notification itself in its own output. Harm: a session can treat its own text as a finished agent or a result that never happened. Fix to find: a check that refuses an assistant message holding notification markup (for example `<task-notification>`), with the lane's sighting as the red case.
